scope: English copy follow-up to merged #622, covering #626 and #621

replacements.source: Ligado, um prompt novo para ${name} espera a resposta em curso terminar, em qualquer conversa. Desligado, segue Configurações › Agentes › Respostas.
replacements.before: On, a new prompt for ${name} waits for the running reply to end, in any conversation. Off, it follows Settings › Agents › Replies.
replacements.after: New prompts for ${name} wait until its current reply finishes, across all conversations. When off, Settings › Agents › Replies applies.
replacements.reason: Replace the awkward On/Off construction; preserve the agent name, all-conversation scope and fallback setting.

replacements.source: Respostas ao mesmo tempo numa conversa
replacements.before: Replies at once in a conversation
replacements.reason: Use the established term for the configured concurrency; synchronize visible, accessible and search labels.

replacements.source: Cada prompt ganha uma resposta própria, ao lado das que já estão em curso. Passando deste número, o prompt espera na fila até uma terminar. Um agente pode ir uma por vez na página dele.
replacements.before: Each prompt gets its own reply beside the running ones. Past this number, it waits in the queue until one ends. An agent can go one at a time on its own page.
replacements.after: New prompts start separate replies up to this limit, then queue until one finishes. An agent can override this with “One reply at a time”.
replacements.reason: Name the limit and the exact per-agent override instead of vague page narration.
